job.title: Sr Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Senior Site Reliability Engineer

Overview
Our client is seeking a Sr Site Reliability Engineer (Automation & GCP) to drive the design, scaling, and operational modernization of critical enterprise cloud infrastructure. In this high-impact position, you will build resilient automation frameworks, manage complex cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and integrate cutting-edge AI/ML capabilities into Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) operations.

In this role, you will balance hands-on engineering execution with high-level architectural strategy. You will design self-healing infrastructure, establish guardrail-driven workflows across CI/CD pipelines, and implement intelligent observability and remediation frameworks across Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Responsibilities
  • Automation Framework Engineering: Design, build, and maintain scalable, robust automation frameworks using Python to manage the full lifecycle of complex cloud infrastructure.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Architect and maintain enterprise IaC environments using Terraform and Terragrunt to ensure consistency, repeatability, and compliance across multi-tenant environments.
  • SRE Tooling & Workflow Integration: Build auditable, guardrail-driven continuous delivery workflows fully integrated with core engineering platforms, including Jira, Git version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • GCP AI/ML Solution Architecture: Design and deploy intelligent, cloud-native automation solutions on Google Cloud Platform to streamline monitoring, alerting, and operational remediation.
  • Self-Healing Infrastructure: Utilize GCP AI services, predictive analytics, and automated orchestration to enable proactive incident response, dynamic resource scaling, and self-healing system workflows.
  • Technical Advisory & Strategic Leadership: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to engineering teams and leadership, guiding best practices in GCP architecture, SRE principles, and AI-driven DevOps automation.

Qualifications & Core Competencies
  • Expert Python Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python for developing CLI tools, operational scripts, and end-to-end infrastructure automation engines.
  • IaC Mastery: Extensive experience architecting and managing enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Terragrunt.
  • Git & CI/CD Pipelines: Deep expertise in Git workflows (including complex branching strategies) and hands-on experience building robust CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deep GCP Expertise: Strong track record of designing and scaling enterprise architectures on Google Cloud Platform (GCP professional certification is a strong plus).
  • AI/ML Operations: Experience integrating AI-driven automation, Vertex AI, or ML pipelines to improve predictive capabilities, observability, and operational efficiency.
  • Configuration Management: Proven ability to parse, validate, and standardize multi-format configuration data (e.g., YAML, INI, HCL) within automated workflows.
  • AI-Ready System Design: Demonstrated capability in designing deterministic automation systems with explicit guardrails tailored for execution by AI agents and automated orchestration engines.
  • Technical Leadership: Excellent communication and advisory skills, with a track record of translating complex technical strategy into clear execution models aligned with business goals.

job.title: Investments Risk, Principal
job.description:
Quantitative Investments Risk Associate (Hedge Funds)


Company Overview


Our client is a premier global alternative asset management firm with a highly respected investments platform. Their established Investments Risk team has built out the firm's core proprietary risk and attribution models, optimization frameworks, alpha analysis, and client reporting infrastructure. They are seeking an experienced professional to help shape investment and portfolio decisions across the firm's hedge fund activity.


Position Overview


In this role, you will use quantitative risk analysis—including alpha decomposition, stress testing, and optimization—to inform manager evaluation, position sizing, and asset allocation. You will build and apply the risk tools and analytics underlying this work, contributing to both internal risk oversight and external investor reporting.


This position offers a high degree of autonomy. While much of the work is well-defined, you will have the opportunity to identify problems worth solving on your own initiative, evolve existing infrastructure, and design roadmaps for unresolved challenges.


Schedule: Hybrid (3 days onsite: Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday).

Key Responsibilities

  • Quantitative Risk Modeling: Build and maintain quantitative risk models and analytics (including factor and alpha decomposition, stress testing, and scenario analysis) working with large, structured datasets (SQL, data lakes) and using Python.
  • Portfolio Construction & Analysis: Support manager evaluation and investment decisions by conducting portfolio risk monitoring and asset allocation analysis.
  • Market Monitoring: Track and interpret risk exposures, factor trends, and capital market conditions relevant to specific hedge fund strategies.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with portfolio managers and the Investment Committee on portfolio construction decisions.
  • Reporting & Presentation: Design and deliver polished risk and performance presentations for internal oversight and external investor transparency requests.

Requirements & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics/Econometrics, Financial Engineering) or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience: 3 to 7 years of experience in investment analysis, risk management, or asset allocation, ideally with exposure to hedge fund or absolute return strategies.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience working with large structured datasets. Comfort using AI-assisted tools where appropriate is a plus.
  • Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into clear, actionable conclusions for investment committees and clients.
  • Presentation: Strong skills in building and delivering highly polished materials in PowerPoint or other reporting formats.
  • Initiative: A self-starter mentality with the judgment and ownership to operate effectively in environments where directions are not always fully specified.

job.title: Cloud and Automation Engineer
job.description:
The Cloud and Infrastructure team owns and operates the systems that power the business: Azure, on-premises hyperconverged infrastructure, and the networking and telephony that connect them. We are growing the team to reduce single points of ownership, build deeper coverage across our platforms, and shift more of our work from manual support toward engineering, automation, and self-service.


We're looking for a Cloud and Automation Engineer who thinks in systems, not just tools. You should be comfortable moving between cloud and on-premises environments, understand how infrastructure, identity, networking, and applications depend on one another, and be driven to replace repetitive manual work with code and process. You'll work as part of cross-functional squads alongside engineering, security, and business partners, so strong collaboration and communication matter as much as technical depth.


This role is well suited to someone who has built real depth in systems and cloud engineering, who is genuinely energized by learning new platforms and approaches, and who wants to help mature a team's practices rather than just execute a backlog. This role is on a hybrid schedule, with office presence expected two days per week.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate infrastructure across Azure and on-premises hyperconverged environments, applying consistent engineering principles regardless of platform.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks using infrastructure-as-code practices, reducing manual and repetitive work across the environment.
  • Partner with cross-functional squads to translate business and application requirements into resilient, secure, and maintainable infrastructure designs.
  • Co-design systems and platforms with application developers, favoring immutable infrastructure patterns so environments are consistently rebuilt from code rather than patched or drifted over time.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our hybrid cloud strategy: helping decide what belongs in the private data center versus Azure, and building the automation that makes those workloads portable and consistently managed.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues that span cloud, virtualization, storage, networking, and identity layers.
  • Establish and document standards, patterns, and runbooks that reduce tribal knowledge and make systems easier for the team to support.
  • Embed SRE principles and engineering practices into how systems are built and how the team works day to day, favoring measurable reliability, proactive detection, and repeatable process over reactive firefighting.
  • Identify opportunities to insource work currently handled by external managed-service partners, and build the automation and monitoring needed to support it internally.
  • Contribute to shifting the team's focus away from bespoke, hand-managed infrastructure and toward *aaS models and reusable, codified platforms, freeing capacity to focus on the systems that enable differentiated business capabilities.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and incident response, contributing to root-cause analysis and durable fixes rather than one-off remediation.
  • Stay current with evolving cloud, virtualization, and automation practices, and bring new approaches back to the team.

Requirements:


Experience

  • A solution-oriented systems engineering mindset, paired with continuous improvement and being easy to work with across teams.
  • 5-10 years of demonstrated experience integrating and automating infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code approaches, in a public cloud (Azure preferred) and in a virtualized or hyperconverged on-premises environment.
  • A track record of solving problems that cross multiple layers of the stack, not just working within a single platform or tool.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or squad-based delivery models, partnering with engineers, architects, and business stakeholders outside your immediate team.

Skills and Approach

  • Demonstrated experience with Terraform and Ansible, ideally applied in an Azure environment.
  • Strong grounding in core systems and cloud engineering principles: availability, scalability, security, cost, and operability, and the ability to reason about trade-offs between them.
  • A builder's mindset: default to automating and codifying solutions rather than performing repeated manual work.
  • A drive to optimize and re-engineer processes where it makes sense, rather than simply automating what's done today as-is.
  • Comfort operating across a hybrid environment, understanding how workload placement decisions affect cost, performance, resiliency, and support burden.
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts and the ability to work back from symptoms to root cause across interdependent systems.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document designs and standards that other engineers can follow.
  • A genuine appetite for learning: comfortable picking up new platforms, tools, and practices as the environment evolves, rather than anchoring to a fixed toolset.
  • Good judgment about when to build, when to buy, and when to simplify rather than automate around unnecessary complexity.
  • A reuse- and security-first mindset, applied in a way that keeps sight of user and developer experience rather than adding friction for its own sake.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to identity and access management, networking, or telephony systems in addition to core infrastructure.
  • Experience contributing to architecture decisions or documentation (e.g., ADRs) rather than only implementing them.
  • Familiarity with reducing reliance on outsourced managed services through internal automation and tooling.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated financial services environment, including familiarity with the risk, compliance, and change-control expectations common there.

job.description:
Analyst - Digital Analytics & Marketing Technology
About the Role
We’re looking for a versatile, detail-oriented Analyst to support our digital analytics and marketing technology function across our client’s brand portfolio.
This role combines hands-on analytics, dashboard development, conversion rate optimization (CRO), marketing technology, and light data engineering. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a pivot table, developing a dashboard, diagnosing a tracking issue, analyzing a conversion funnel, or writing a Python script to clean and transform data.
You’ll work with tools including Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), GA4, Salesforce, and BI platforms to understand user behavior, measure campaign performance, identify opportunities, and translate data into actionable insights for marketing, product, analytics, IT, and leadership stakeholders.
This is an ongoing engagement rather than a fixed-term project, with flexible weekly hours based on business needs and workload.
What You’ll Do
Analytics & Measurement

  • Support recurring digital marketing performance reporting, including year-over-year (YoY) analysis of sessions, leads, RFS/sample orders, RFQs, and homeowner leads.
  • Monitor and interpret KPIs across traffic, engagement, conversion paths, and attribution using GA4 and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Build and maintain regional and market-level performance analyses and pivots.
  • Identify, investigate, and communicate performance anomalies, data quality issues, and structural shifts in reporting.

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Build, maintain, and optimize dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, and/or Adobe CJA.
  • Develop reporting for a range of audiences, from executive-level summaries to detailed analyst views.
  • Ensure dashboards are accurate, scalable, intuitive, and aligned with stakeholder needs.
  • Translate complex data into clear visualizations and actionable insights.

Marketing & CRO Analysis

  • Analyze conversion funnels, user journeys, and site behavior to identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Support feature-impact analysis, such as evaluating how new website tools or functionality influence quote and request conversions.
  • Investigate changes in user behavior and conversion performance to help identify potential drivers and opportunities.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear narratives and recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Martech & Data Engineering

  • Support Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) implementation and analytics measurement, including event-tracking validation, AEP Debugger reviews, and schema alignment.
  • Perform data validation, QA, and troubleshooting across analytics implementations, including tag management and event-based tracking using Adobe Launch or similar platforms.
  • Support and enhance Python-based Salesforce lead reporting scripts, including data extraction, deduplication, geographic segmentation, and market-level reporting.
  • Troubleshoot data pipeline and API issues, including Salesforce API authentication, data quality, and integration challenges.
  • Partner with analytics, marketing, IT, and data teams to resolve reporting and measurement issues.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–3+ years of experience in digital analytics, web analytics, marketing analytics, or marketing technology (MarTech), ideally in a B2C, building products, or home improvement environment.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4 and/or Adobe Customer Journey Analytics.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, and/or Adobe CJA.

job.description:
Category Merchandising Specialist

About the Role

We’re seeking a Category Merchandising Specialist to help bring horizontal business strategies to life across a dynamic, multi-category marketplace. This role combines strong merchandising instincts, operational excellence, and data-informed decision-making to create compelling experiences that help customers discover unique and relevant products.

The Category Merchandising Specialist will support one or more horizontal businesses spanning multiple categories, customer missions, or inventory segments. Working closely with Senior Category Leads, this role will execute established strategies through inventory curation, content development, performance reporting, and cross-functional coordination.

The ideal candidate will develop a deep understanding of the businesses they support—including their audiences, inventory, performance, seasonal rhythms, and competitive landscape—and use that knowledge to deliver high-quality customer experiences.

This is a hands-on role for a strong operator and merchant who enjoys translating strategy into action. You’ll manage multiple workstreams, maintain a high bar for accuracy and quality, and adapt as merchandising tools, processes, and priorities evolve.

What You’ll Do

Execute Business Strategies

  • Execute strategies, priorities, and roadmaps established by Senior Category Leads for assigned business areas.

  • Translate strategic direction and customer insights into clear merchandising deliverables, including collections, landing pages, content modules, and marketing assets.

  • Support seasonal, evergreen, and real-time programming by sourcing inventory, building experiences, refreshing content, and coordinating launches.

  • Develop a strong understanding of each business’s audience, inventory, performance, and competitive context to strengthen day-to-day execution.

  • Identify relevant inventory, trends, sellers, and cultural moments that align with established business priorities.

Deliver Merchandising Excellence

  • Curate differentiated, high-quality inventory that reflects the marketplace’s unique strengths and the objectives of each business.

  • Build and maintain merchandising experiences ranging from highly curated landing pages to scaled, algorithmically driven collections that support personalized discovery.

  • Apply strong editorial and visual judgment to ensure compelling inventory is consistently highlighted across onsite and marketing touchpoints.

  • Support category storytelling through collection development, seller spotlights, inventory augmentation, and campaign content.

  • Ensure merchandising experiences authentically represent the breadth and diversity of the marketplace.

Support Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor business, collection, and listing performance using established reporting and success metrics.

  • Surface meaningful trends, risks, inventory gaps, and execution opportunities to Senior Category Leads.

  • Support measurement of merchandising initiatives by gathering results, documenting learnings, and identifying potential optimizations.

  • Use performance data and customer signals to inform inventory selection, content refreshes, and day-to-day merchandising decisions.

  • Develop a strong understanding of key sellers, their inventory, and their needs; support seller outreach and synthesize feedback to inform execution and surface opportunities.

  • Make recommendations within established strategies regarding where programming could be improved, refreshed, or expanded.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Build, publish, and quality-check merchandising experiences using content management and merchandising platforms.

  • Manage assigned deliverables against established briefs, calendars, and launch timelines.

  • Maintain accurate documentation and communicate progress, risks, and dependencies to Senior Category Leads.

  • Coordinate inputs, feedback, and approvals across Merchandising, Marketing, Brand, Creative, Product, and other cross-functional partners.

  • Learn and adapt to emerging tools and processes that enable more scalable, dynamic, and personalized merchandising.

  • Contribute to broader team priorities and support new executional needs as they arise.

About You

  • 2–4 years of experience in merchandising, ecommerce, content programming, marketplace operations, retail, or a related field.

  • Strong merchandising instincts with an eye for compelling inventory, product presentation, and storytelling.

  • Comfortable using data to evaluate performance, identify patterns, and inform executional decisions.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and shifting timelines.

  • Experience working with content management, ecommerce, or merchandising systems.

  • Able to work independently within clear strategic direction while proactively identifying questions, risks, and opportunities.

  • Strong collaborator with the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new tools, systems, and processes.

  • Passion for creativity, independent commerce, and creating meaningful customer experiences.

job.title: Market Risk Consultant
job.description:
Market Risk Consultant

Position Overview

A leading financial institution is launching a new Securities Clearing House, which will initially offer clearing services for cash treasuries as well as Bilateral and Tri-party Repo. The Market Risk Consultant will be responsible for the daily monitoring of market risk and managing obligations in the event of a clearing member default.

The consultant will perform in-depth research and analysis of market, credit, and trading data to identify risks, develop mitigation processes, and present findings to senior management. The candidate serves as the first line of defense against systemic, idiosyncratic, and counterparty-specific risks by performing daily assessments of market conditions.

Additionally, this role is responsible for measuring key risks, creating reports for internal governance committees, and escalating issues as appropriate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Liaise with market risk, financial surveillance, and other departments to familiarize stakeholders with counterparty credit, liquidity, and collateral risk profiles.

  • Risk Monitoring & Stress Testing: Perform daily procedures to monitor risk to the clearinghouse, including credit and liquidity stress testing, and escalate findings as necessary.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Demonstrate a strong understanding of applicable domestic and international regulations, as well as a firm grasp of the clearinghouse’s internal rule book.

  • Model Maintenance: Use technical skills—including knowledge of programming and financial mathematics—to maintain risk models.

  • Regulatory Reporting: Assist in preparing responses to ad hoc regulatory requests.

Skills and Software Requirements

  • Market Knowledge: Strong understanding of Fixed Income, Cash Treasuries, and Repo Markets.

  • Technical Proficiency: Experienced in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

  • Financial Tools: Proficiency with Bloomberg terminals.

  • Data Management: Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle) and SQL, with the ability to manipulate large data sets.

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical, quantitative, financial analysis (intermediate level), and organizational skills.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present findings clearly to senior management.

  • Work Style: Capability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team setting.

Work Schedule

Note: This position requires a daily presence in our office, 5 days a week.

job.title: Cybersecurity Lead Engineer /Architect
job.description:
The Cybersecurity Lead Engineer/Architect is the firm’s most senior individual contributor in security, joining a lean security operations team responsible for the continued evolution, design, and advancement of the firm’s cybersecurity program. This role deliberately blends high-level strategy and security architecture direction with hands-on implementation engineering: setting the technical vision, reference architectures, and standards while personally building, configuring, and hardening the controls that bring them to life. The role safeguards the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of firm data and systems in alignment with organizational policies and regulatory expectations, leading the design and implementation of security architecture, controls, and technical solutions across the enterprise while proactively identifying risks and recommending strategic improvements.

This individual operates as a highly self-directed contributor within a team responsible for cybersecurity and enterprise risk. The role requires independent assessment of emerging threats, evaluation of control effectiveness, prioritization of initiatives, and ownership of security-focused projects and architectural roadmaps from concept through execution. The Cybersecurity Lead Engineer/Architect regularly collaborates with infrastructure, software engineering, and service desk teams to drive measurable improvements in the firm’s security posture.

As an onsite/hybrid employee, you are expected to be in the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursday.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, design, implement, and continuously enhance security controls across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and SDLC, operating hands-on from design through deployment and tuning.
  • Lead security-focused projects, including scoping, planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and documentation.
  • Own and optimize core security tooling (Application security, AI security, endpoint protection, IDS/IPS, SIEM, vulnerability management, cloud security, etc.), ensuring effective configuration and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and implement automation to enhance threat detection, alerting, response workflows, ticket creation, and reporting metrics.
  • Partner with cross-functional technology teams to embed secure design principles and hardening standards into infrastructure, cloud platforms, and application development (DevSecOps).
  • Lead the firm’s AI security program, establishing governance, guardrails, and technical controls that secure the enterprise’s adoption and use of AI
  • Partner with product and software engineering teams to enable secure AI engineering and development, embedding threat modeling, secure-by-design patterns, and safeguards.
  • Monitor compliance with cybersecurity policies and regulatory requirements; identify gaps and drive remediation efforts.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point during incident response and contribute to post-incident analysis and control improvements.
  • Identify emerging threats, tools, and technologies and recommend strategic direction for the cybersecurity program.

EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity or information security engineering roles, including time in a lead, principal, or security architect capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and engineering security controls in enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading or independently managing technical security projects.
  • Strong familiarity with CIS Framework and system hardening standards.
  • Hands-on experience securing and monitoring cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of common security controls including DLP, MFA, encryption, intrusion detection, and mobile device/application management.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Python, or similar) with software engineering experience preferred
  • Experience designing and maintaining centralized logging and SIEM solutions.
  • Ability to independently assess risk, define problems, and implement practical, scalable solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and represent the security function effectively.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise security architecture and reference architectures, balancing strategic, roadmap-level direction with hands-on implementation.
  • Experience securing AI/ML systems and enterprise AI adoption, including familiarity with AI-specific risks (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse) and frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Experience threat modeling and partnering with software and product engineering teams to enable secure AI and application development.
  • Experience in financial services or investment management preferred.
  • Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CISM, GIAC, AWS Security, etc.) are a plus.
